message.content: 在標準的撲克遊戲（例如德州撲克）中，每位玩家都會被發兩張私人手牌，而桌面上的公共牌則由所有玩家共享。因為每個玩家收到的手牌數量相同，所以沒有任何一位玩家會比其他人持有更多的紙牌。若你指的是莊家或發牌者，他們也不會額外持有比其他玩家更多的手牌；他們只是負責輪流發牌並在每局結束後把「莊家位置」轉給下一位玩家。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "在撲克牌遊戲中，誰擁有最多的紙牌？" which translates to "In a poker game, who has the most cards?" They want to know who holds the most cards. In standard poker games like Texas Hold'em, each player gets two private cards (hole cards). But the dealer deals community cards to all players. So no one has more than others. However, if we consider the dealer or the dealer's role? In Texas Hold'em, the dealer button rotates; each player gets two cards. So no one has more. But maybe the question is ambiguous. We can answer: In Texas Hold'em, each player receives two cards, so no one has more. If you consider the dealer, they don't hold extra cards beyond the community ones. So answer accordingly.
